create_csn_model: create a CSN model for video classification with default ResNet-50 depth and 400 classes
create_csn_custom_depth: create a CSN model with ResNet-101 depth for video classification on a custom dataset
create_csn_depthwise: create a CSN model using depthwise convolution by setting stage_conv_b_width_per_group to 1
create_csn_no_dropout: create a CSN model with dropout disabled and global average pooling on the head output
create_csn_custom_stem: create a CSN model with a custom stem kernel size and stride for short video clips
